name: Second Sunrise Solar
old_description: The average home can save between $10,000 and $30,000 over the lifetime of your solar panel system.
about:
Second Sunrise Solar operates from Mt Pleasant, South Carolina. The company describes itself as a family-run business, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides full-service solar photovoltaic installation for residential and commercial customers. Its scope covers initial consultation, system design, financing assistance, permitting, installation, grid interconnection, and ongoing monitoring. In addition to solar, the company performs Gold Star Certified Building Performance Institute (BPI) energy audits and installs efficiency upgrades such as insulation, air and duct sealing, smart thermostats, radiant barriers, solar attic fans, LED lighting, and hybrid water heaters. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The customer base includes homeowners and businesses across the company’s service area. Reviews cite projects for individual residences and note commercial-scale installations, though specific client names are not disclosed.

Second Sunrise Solar emphasizes a “full service” model that keeps every step in-house, a 25-year parts and production warranty on panels, racking, and inverters, and an industry-leading 10-year workmanship warranty. The company says it began each project with a BPI energy audit to maximize overall energy and financial savings.
